title: The focused gate misses live-kb tests, repo-wide scans and deleted test files
goal: testmap.py's content lane also selects test_route.py::TestRouteEvalSet, test_kb_mcp.py::TestKbServer, test_kbfacts_imports.py and test_kb.py::TestToolChecks; every selection short of all includes test_kb.py::TestLeaks, backlog items included; a changed tool module also selects test_kb.py::TestCohesion; README.md, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md make the gate run check.py; a deleted test file or runner selects nothing instead of a missing path; .claude/settings.json selects test_change_router.py; and test_testmap.py's testmap_review_gaps tests plant each case.
notes: Found by the sprint review of SP-ddjk2p5l “Focused gate”: tests outside test_kb.py assert on the live kb (route eval set, kb_mcp server answers, the kb's signals.csv); the leak scan, ruff and the contract lint live in test_kb.py and were selected only for content paths; check.py also validates the root README.md and AGENTS.md; a deleted test file was passed to pytest as a missing path (exit 4); .claude/settings.json was a generic name.
